[quote=new_westmore;61614508][b]This Town Ain't Big Enough[/b]
[i]New Westmore, with assistance from the Iroccoans, has determined that the recent spat in Dalesburg International Airport was not an act of terrorism. Rather, it was the first sign of a new gang in the nation's criminal underworld. Federal Police have confirmed that the Maiqahstan Cartel, a criminal organisation with roots in the recently-annexed nation of Maiqahstan, have rooted themselves in New Westmore and are in some sort of union with a local ethnic gang known as the Brothers 4 Life. Raids conducted in Randwick seized more than $400,000 worth of contraband drugs and arms imported by the Cartel's links.

This revelation has reflected poorly on President Lundy and his attempts to curb illegal immigration in the country. Critics have used the discovery to argue that Lundy's stricter border control policies are not working at all, and that if he truly wants to put an end to illegal entry into New Westmore he needs to do more to make sure it cannot happen again. Lundy has apologised to the Sealiphate of Irocco, and has condemned the Maiqahstan Cartel, calling them "evil, evil people who have entered this nation with the intent to undermine everything we stand for."

Further investigations are underway to figure out the scope and size of the Cartel's operation in New Westmore.[/i]

...

[i]Isa Rahat throws down a cigar and crushes it with his foot.

"F*ck! F*ck, f*ck, f*ck!" He screams.

He picks up his phone and calls someone, presumably a member of the Cartel.

"We need to find another way to get your product into New Westmore, brother. They've completely busted our operation in Dalesburg. The 858 are already using this as a way to get ahead of us. Anyway, I have an idea, but I need to know if you have the means to support it."

He stares at a small map of New Westmore on his desk. His eyes settle on a particularly tiny island on the east coast.

"We're going to seize Recession City for ourselves. Let's hit our rivals hard and fast, where it hurts the most. I'll do the grunt work of figuring out who we can use in the city, and once it's done I'll call you back."

Rahat hangs up and begins to plan in silence.[/i]

[i][u][b]USO is imposing strict trade security on New Westmore. [/b][/u]

The Federal Assembly of the Grand House and President Frederick J. Krump has discussed a new policy called States 1050 Bill, and declaring a nationwide war on illegal trafficking operations within USO borders.

The FBSI and FDEA have launched joint operations targeting human and non-human trafficking, illegal drugs, weapons distribution, and support networks for hostile forces. The Enclave Federal Commonwealth has issued a national security order in response to rising threats.

Military grade weapons proliferation has become a major concern due to the growth of micro terror groups and organized gangs. Among the most prominent threats are Ultra Neo-Human Nationalist groups that have recently taken part in mass shootings in South Beach.

Advanced surveillance and intelligence systems from Palantir Technologies Company have been integrated into national and state security systems, with civil oversight to implement a safeguard on citizens rights.

[u]The States' 1050 Bill has been voted on with the results of the outcome[/u]

In Favor: 462
Opposed: 263
Abstained:  75

[u]President Frederick J. Krump Speech[/u]

My fellow citizens,

Tonight, our nation takes decisive action. The States 1050 Bill has been passed, and with it, we begin to secure Oceanica interest from the people.
This is a direct message to traffickers, smugglers, and extremists,  your time is over.

We are launching a full scale crackdown on illegal trafficking. We will secure our trade, protect our streets, and defend our people. And we ask the New Westmore to take care of their issue, and we USO will focus on stopping the flow of danger into our nation.

Our agencies will act as one, using every tool available from our advanced systems of Palantir to stop threats before they reach our citizens, while maintaining strong protections for civil liberties. 
To those who threaten Oceanica, we are ready. Lets make USO great again. 

[nation]Shahzada[/nation] RP
